sourceTitle: Fees and allowances (Foster Croydon, Croydon Council)
feesNote: Croydon pays a weekly skills fee to the carer on top of the maintenance allowance for each child, set by the carer's level.
extras: Retention bonus of £1,500 a year after 3 years of fostering for Croydon
Welcome bonus of £1,500 for carers transferring from another service
Birthday and festival allowances of up to £309 a year each
Holiday allowance of up to £618 a year for the child and up to £700 a year for the carer
Start-up grant of £500 and a school uniform allowance of £300 a year
summary: Croydon publishes a maintenance allowance by the child's age and a separate skills fee for the carer, so a newly approved carer receives £533 to £634 a week for one child and an advanced carer £658 to £759. The council does not state on the page which year the rates apply from, so check the current figures with Foster Croydon before you apply.
